name: moment-seal
description: Snapshot-to-commit consistency compiler for AI-agent plans.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @momentseal/core build && pnpm --filter @momentseal/node build && pnpm --filter @momentseal/cli build && pnpm --filter @momentseal/studio build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.build.json packages/node/tsconfig.build.json packages/cli/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p apps/studio/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && node scripts/e2e.mjs && node scripts/benchmark.mjs && node scripts/verify-reproducible-release.mjs
scripts.premoment: pnpm --filter @momentseal/core build && pnpm --filter @momentseal/node build && pnpm --filter @momentseal/cli build
